A '''battle''' was a battle of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]], in [[3996 BBY]]. At the [[Abron system]], the two sides fought with the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] emerging as the victors.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was referenced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It only illustrates the battle on the galactic map rather than in prose.
